**Ratio Analysis & Overall Sentiment:**

The sharp decrease in sales coupled with the net loss significantly outweighs any positive effects from asset or equity growth. The negative net income and shrinking revenue suggest underlying operational or market issues. Although some ratios like current ratio and other expenses were lower, it is outweighed by the sales decline.
